author: logwhat
quote: Gears of War: E-Day delivers that classic, gritty gameplay and the incredible rush of playing as Marcus Fenix again, but it hits a major wall with a frustrating narrative bait-and-switch. Despite being heavily marketed as the ultimate origin story for Marcus and Dom, the two icons are frequently sidelined as a supporting cast to Maggie. The developers just can't seem to help themselves when it comes to this type of deceptive marketing, proving once again that they never learn from past backlash. While the core gameplay and nostalgia are definitely there, the story leaves a bitter taste for anyone expecting the true Marcus and Dom prequel they were promised.
